SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s."School ID") AS charter_schools_count
FROM "Schools" s
JOIN "SAT Scores" sat ON s."School ID" = sat."School ID"
WHERE s."School Type" = 'Charter'
  AND CAST(sat."Math Avg. Score" AS INTEGER) > 560;
498:
SELECT DISTINCT "s"."name"
FROM "sets" "s"
JOIN "set_translations" "st" ON "s"."id" = "st"."set_id"
JOIN "cards" "c" ON "s"."id" = "c"."set_id"
JOIN "card_translations" "ct" ON "c"."id" = "ct"."card_id"
WHERE "st"."language" = 'French'
  AND "ct"."language" = 'French'
  AND "ct"."name" = 'Tendo Ice Bridge';
1533:
SELECT DISTINCT t."Client_ID",
       c."Consumption_Status"
FROM "Transactions" t
JOIN "Clients" c ON t."Client_ID" = c."Client_ID"
WHERE t."Product_ID" = '5'
  AND (t."Price"::numeric / NULLIF(t."Amount"::numeric, 0)) > 29.00
  AND t."Date" LIKE '201208%'
GROUP BY t."Client_ID", c."Consumption_Status";
1472:
SELECT t."Customer_Name"
FROM "Transactions" t
JOIN "Yearmonth" ym ON TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(t."Date", 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYYMM') = ym."Yearmonth"
WHERE ym."Yearmonth" BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'
  AND t."Region" = 'LAM'
GROUP BY t."Customer_Name"
ORDER BY SUM(CAST(REPLACE(t."Consumption", ',', '.') AS FLOAT)) ASC
LIMIT 1;
589:
SELECT "user_id"
FROM "users"
ORDER BY CAST("reputation" AS INTEGER) DESC
LIMIT 1;
